text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Fest. A great
number of
fans are visiting, and Smart
Falcon is in high
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaaah! ☆

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
After kicking up the sand with fearsome
strength,
Smart Falcon takes first in the
Digging for
Treasure Dirt Race!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
The cloud of sand in your wake was a
sight to see!
Can you share your
thoughts with us?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sure! ☆ My goal is to take first in every
race this
year! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Teio Sho in June! Please
come
watch! ♪

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator A
text_block_list.text: Um... I meant about... this race...

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
What a shocker! Smart Falcon is the last
one to
finish, bringing the Round 'n
Round Rotating Race
to a close!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! It looks like she's still dizzy! She
can't even
stand! Hey, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like the camera and shotgun mic
are both in
place. This is it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to take first in every race this
year!
Come and witness the birth of a
legend! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Groan... First... in every... race... ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Come... and... s—thud! ☆

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator C
text_block_list.text:
Give it up for Smart Falcon and her
stirring
performance in the eating
contest! She managed
to keep a big
smile from start to finish!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... My stomach still feels packed to
bursting
with fried rice...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was nothing! This is a great chance to
attract
tons of different fans. I need to
do even more to
promote my races.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's see... The next contest is—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hi, Falcon. You were great out there.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I saw the eating contest just now. You
seemed so
intense.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! I'm so happy you were
watching! ☆ Can I
give you a hug? ♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, that's okay...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon and Silence Suzuka banter
happily
together. As I watch their
friendly antics...

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look over there! It's Silence Suzuka
and...

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
She's with the Silence Suzuka of the
Sand!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Uhhh... When they say, "Silence
Suzuka of
the Sand"...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Are they talking about me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon has been showing
"otherworldly"
strength in her recent dirt
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reminded of Silence Suzuka's
overwhelming
achievements on turf, fans
have taken to calling
Falcon by this new
nickname.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Me? Like Suzuka?! Wooow, I'm so
happy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? But... I'm the only Silence Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Bystanders
text_block_list.text: OHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka won't let Smart Falcon
steal her
name! She's thrown down the
gauntlet!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate showdown between two
different
worlds—turf and dirt! Now
this'll be a sight to see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The situation escalates quickly, and
before I know
it...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everybody! I'm Suzuka's
roommate, Special
Week!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And I'm Falcon's roommate, Eishin
Flash... coming
to you live...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, what are we doing again? I'm
supposed to
participate in the next
event in thirty-five
minutes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Falco and Suzuka are about to compete
over the
name "Silence Suzuka of the
Sand"!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Here's how it's gonna work! The real
Suzuka is
known for her speedy front
running, so of course
there's only one
way to settle this...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
With a lightning-fast word-chain game!
Each word
has to start with the last
letter of the word
before—but there's a
catch! If your word ends in
the letter "n,"
you lose!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me, may I ask a question?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't you agree that there can only
be one
Silence Suzuka? And I'm not sure
I understand the
rationale behind
settling this with a game of—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right, that does it for question time!
Let's get
this show on the road!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the game begins...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "C"... "Cleats."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha! The moment I've been waiting for!
That ends
in "s," so naturally I choose...
"Smart Falcon"! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, that ends in "n"! Nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And it's decided! Smart Falcon blunders,
and
Suzuka gets to keep her name!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Um, what exactly was the point of all
this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's only due to being the
original Suzuka,
but Silence Suzuka
claims victory in the end.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "K"... "Kobe Shimbun Hai."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Another "i"? Come on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's the third in a row! You don't mess
around,
Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
There just happen to be a lot of race
names
ending in "i"...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to run out of—actually, I
think I'm
already out of ideas! I've got
nothing!

text_block_list.name: Falco Fans
text_block_list.text:
Falcooo!
You got this! Don't give up yet!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, my cute little brain! You can
do this!
Don't fail me now! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! "Idoldom." Because I'm
gonna rise to
the top of idoldom!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"M"... Oh—I think I ran in a race called
the...
"Mainichi Okan."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And it's decided! Smart Falcon is the
winner!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! ☆ Now I'm Suzuka too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait? Am I Suzuka?! Eh, whatever! All I know is that I'm happy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Goodness.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Falcon, about the name... It's
embarrassing, so...
try not to overuse it,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: S-sure thing! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hi, everyone! ☆ From now on, I'm
officially the
Silence Suzuka of the
Sand! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to take first in every race this
year, so
come and watch! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The showdown over the name Suzuka
ends in a
victory for Smart Falcon. As a
result, dirt racing
gains more attention!
